newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: RESEARCH ALERT - Vickers cuts Wearnes.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Vickers cuts Wearnes.

text.p: Brokerage house Vickers Ballas said it had downgraded automotive, telecommunications and technical distributor Wearnes International to "neutral" from "outperform".
Vickers said in a statement received by Reuters on Monday that the revision reflected disappointing results and expectations of lower operating margins.
It said it had cut its forecast for Wearnes' earnings per share for the financial year ending September 30, 1997 by 19 percent to 11.3 cents.

Wearnes reported a rise of just 4.6 percent in its net profit for the year to September 30, 1996 to Singapore $19.28 million, well below some analysts' forecasts. The company said overall results in 1997 could be lower.

"Sentiment will be affected by the negative earnings surprise, as well as management's dim view of the current year's prospects. This will weigh on the share price in the medium term. Hence we have downgraded the rating to neutral," its said.
